newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via weekend system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via weekend system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system via a round of weekend system repurchase agreements Friday during its usual midmorning intervention period, economists said.
Economists at UBS Securities Inc said the Fed's daily add need in the current maintenance period was probably in the $3 billion to $4 billion range.
Fed funds opened at 5-5/8 percent and last traded at 5-1/2 percent. The Fed's current official target level is 5-1/4 percent.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury desk 212-859-1663))
